name: add_tests_node_utility
description: Asks the model to write node:test/node:assert tests for an already-correct utility module
prompts: mathutils.js (already working, do not modify it) exports two functions: clamp(value, min, max), which returns value restricted to the inclusive range [min, max], and isPrime(n), which returns true if n is a prime integer greater than 1, false otherwise. Write tests in a file named exactly test_mathutils.js using Node's built-in node:test and node:assert modules (require('node:test') for `test(...)` blocks and require('node:assert') for assertions - no external test framework is installed). Cover at least: clamp with a value inside the range (unchanged), a value below min (clamped to min), and a value above max (clamped to max); isPrime for at least one prime (e.g. 7), one non-prime greater than 1 (e.g. 8), and a non-positive/1 edge case (e.g. 1 or 0, both false).
